O ponto central pode ser explicado assim.es: El punto central puede explicarse así: **el prompt no murió; dejó de ser el “producto final” y se convirtió solo en una capa de orientación.** Con modelos más autónomos, el valor migra de “escribir el prompt perfecto” a **definir intención, contexto, reglas, herramientas, memoria, habilidades y criterios de éxito**. **Antes:** Prompt → respuesta. **Ahora:** Objetivo → contexto → agente → habilidades → herramientas → ejecución → validación → resultado. En una frase fuerte: > **La era del prompt perfecto está terminando. La nueva habilidad es enseñar a la IA a trabajar.** Y eso encaja muy bien en **FEP 2026** como evolución de *Ingeniería de Prompt* a algo mayor: **Ingeniería de Intención + Contexto + Ejecución**.
O ponto central pode ser explicado assim.en: The central point can be explained like this: **the prompt hasn't died; it stopped being the “final product” and became just a guidance layer.** With more autonomous models, the value shifts from “writing the perfect prompt” to **defining intention, context, rules, tools, memory, skills, and success criteria**. **Before:** Prompt → response. **Now:** Goal → context → agent → skills → tools → execution → validation → result. Or, in a strong sentence: > **The era of the perfect prompt is ending. The new skill is teaching the AI to work.** And this fits very well in **FEP 2026** as an evolution of *Engenharia de Prompt* to something bigger: **Engenharia de Intenção + Contexto + Execução**.

Aquí está todo lo que necesitas saber: QUÉ HAY DE NUEVO 1) 🧠 Trabajo de larga duración más confiable: Fable 5.1 mantiene la consistencia incluso en tareas complejas, donde un error inicial podría arruinar el resultado final. 2) 💻 Codificación más robusta: Mejor en grandes refactorizaciones, revisiones de código, depuración de causas raíz y funcionalidades que abarcan toda la base de código. 3) 📊 Entregas finalizadas de mejor calidad: Puede llevar la investigación hasta un informe refinado, una hoja de cálculo interactiva o una presentación con fuentes verificables. 4) 🔍 Mejora en la investigación y el uso de computadoras: Mejor en búsquedas con varias etapas, lectura de PDFs densos y recuperación cuando las acciones del navegador o del escritorio fallan. 5) 💰 Flujos de trabajo de agentes más económicos: Los precios estándar permanecen US$ 10 para entrada y US$ 50 para salida por millón de tokens, pero las lecturas de caché son 75% más baratas. Apresenta o **Claude Fable 5.1** como um.en:
It presents **Claude Fable 5.1** as an important evolution of Fable 5, especially for **programming, agents, and complex intellectual work**.  
* **Performance:** according to the benchmarks presented, Fable 5.1 significantly outperforms Fable 5. A highlight is that, in some tests, **5.1 with low effort outperforms Fable 5 using maximum effort**.  
* **Price per token:** remains at **US$10/million input tokens and US$50/million output tokens**, according to the video.  
* **Lower effective cost:** the claim is about **25% savings on typical workflows** and potentially **up to ~50% on highly agentic tasks**, mainly due to higher efficiency and reduced cache read pricing.  
* **Agents and coding:** the biggest advances appear to be in **agentic coding, terminal use, multidisciplinary reasoning, and autonomous task execution**.  
* **Design/front-end:** an improvement is also noticeable in visual generation. In a simple test, a **3D bear riding a bicycle** was requested; 5.1 produced shadows, physics, and appearance considered better.  
* **Cost test:** in the shown example, Fable 5.1 would have cost approximately **US$4.53**, versus **US$5.41** for Fable 5. That is about **16% less** in this specific test.  
* **Mythos 5.1:** would essentially be Fable 5.1 with **more permissive safeguards**, aimed at verified users in **cybersecurity and life sciences**. It would not be generally accessible.  
* **Enterprise and privacy:** a new system for enterprise customers is mentioned, allowing stricter **data retention/privacy** policies.  
* **Availability:** according to the video, the models would be available on Claude, API, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.  

### The most important point  
The big news **would not simply be “a smarter model.”** It would be the combination: **more capacity + less computational effort + fewer tokens + lower real cost.** This is especially important for **agents**, because an agent can make dozens or hundreds of model calls. A 25–50% reduction in effective cost, combined with greater ability to solve tasks on the first try, can significantly change the economic viability of agentic systems.  

**But there is an important caveat:** the launch had just happened and the tests were still preliminary. The benchmarks presented by the manufacturer and the bear test **are not sufficient to conclude that 5.1 is always vastly superior or 25–50% cheaper** in real‑world applications.
